scenes.caption: What if a trickster used a magical fishhook to pull the land from the sea? Across Polynesian traditions, Māui is a restless trickster and culture hero. Some stories say he hid a miraculous fishhook aboard his brothers’ canoe.
scenes.intended_emotion: curious wonder turning into secretive anticipation
scenes.emotional_turn: a playful trickster reveals a dangerous plan aboard the canoe
scenes.visual_evidence: the concealed luminous hook and brothers' canoe establish the scheme before the sea answers
